name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline message about this place (top of a form, inside a card, along a page): the kind's glyph in a sunk window with its LED in the corner, a title, a description that wraps, actions and an optional close key. Kinds note, done, waiting, urgent, failed; tones plate, quiet, strong; a banner; solid on see-through grounds. It arrives rising, morphs its glyph when its kind changes, and leaves when dismissed; never by itself.
base: none (a live region, role alert or status; the close key is IconButton)
